insights.one_liner: Amsterdam cybersecurity startup using agentic AI to hack like attackers, freshly funded with $40M and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: An offensive cybersecurity startup, founded in August 2021, building AI agents that probe systems from a hacker's perspective.
Based in Amsterdam and backed by ABN AMRO Ventures and Cherry Ventures.

open.text: Hadrian Security B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open senior software engineering role in Amsterdam needs no Dutch.

growth.text: Raised $40 million (about €36 million) to scale its agentic AI offensive security platform.
Belgian investor Smartfin joined as a backer in the new round.
